name: yahoo_web_search
description: Search the Yahoo! JAPAN web index. Best general-purpose tool for finding Japanese web pages, shops, official sites and documentation. Returns title, URL, snippet and the source site, plus related queries Yahoo suggests. 10 results per page.

query.description: Search query. Japanese works best; Yahoo! JAPAN indexes Japanese-language content far more deeply than other engines.

updated.description: Restrict by last update. Yahoo offers only these windows — there is no month option.

site.description: Restrict to one host, e.g. "go.jp" or "example.co.jp". Applied as a site: operator.

name: yahoo_image_search
description: Search Yahoo! JAPAN images. Returns the source page, the original image URL, a Yahoo-cached copy that stays reachable when the origin blocks hotlinking, a thumbnail and pixel dimensions. 20 results per page.

query.description: Search query. Japanese works best; Yahoo! JAPAN indexes Japanese-language content far more deeply than other engines.

name: yahoo_video_search
description: Search Yahoo! JAPAN videos across YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Niconico and other hosts. Returns title, watch URL, uploader, duration, upload date and a summary. 20 results per page.

query.description: Search query. Japanese works best; Yahoo! JAPAN indexes Japanese-language content far more deeply than other engines.

name: yahoo_news_search
description: Search Yahoo!ニュース for Japanese news articles. Returns headline, article URL, publisher, publish time, category and a snippet. Use this over web search for current events in Japan. Yahoo returns one batch of up to 60 articles and does not paginate.

query.description: Search query. Japanese works best; Yahoo! JAPAN indexes Japanese-language content far more deeply than other engines.

name: yahoo_realtime_search
description: Search Yahoo!リアルタイム検索 for X (Twitter) posts. Best for what people in Japan are saying right now — breaking incidents, service outages, live reactions. Returns post text, author, timestamp and engagement counts. 40 results per page.

query.description: Search query. Japanese works best; Yahoo! JAPAN indexes Japanese-language content far more deeply than other engines.

name: yahoo_chiebukuro_search
description: Search Yahoo!知恵袋, Japan's largest community Q&A site. Best for real-world Japanese consumer questions, troubleshooting and local know-how that rarely appears on formal sites. Returns question title, URL, status, answer/view counts and category path. 10 results per page.

query.description: Search query. Japanese works best; Yahoo! JAPAN indexes Japanese-language content far more deeply than other engines.

status.description: Filter by question state: all, open (回答受付中), vote (投票受付中), solved (解決済み).

name: yahoo_suggest_keywords
description: Get Yahoo! JAPAN autocomplete suggestions for a partial query. Useful for discovering how Japanese users actually phrase a topic before running a full search.

name: yahoo_list_verticals
description: List the Yahoo! JAPAN search verticals this server exposes, with the tool name and paging behaviour of each. Call this to decide which search tool fits a question.
